decisions.reason: Management would still tend to defend a recently introduced carpet with public presentation and sunk design and marketing effort, though as one of several similar low-pile rugs it faces some rising rationalization risk.
The hand-knotted wool-silk carpet fits the firm's craftsmanship and fine-material identity, so prior commitment and reputational justification make continued support more likely than withdrawal.
Escalation of commitment supports keeping this publicly launched carpet, but its closeness to other low-pile decorative carpets makes it one of the easier products to trim if the range is simplified.
Because the corner bench extends the firm's core furniture offer for residential and project interiors, management has strong grounds to continue backing it despite any muted early signals.

Previously committed resources and the absence of clear failure favor persistence, yet this carpet remains less central than core furniture lines and is vulnerable if management consolidates overlapping accessories.

The swivel shell chair line represents broader visible commitment across several models and aligns with flexible workplace concepts, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it on the market.
